sections.kicker: Prepared for Lila by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your Instagram and your site the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Lila sells colour and play. The site hero and the grid show two different products.
sections.keep: The pink logo and the stripes. Lila looks like itself from a distance.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.
Three things
people meet
first.

pins.quote: We make everyday outfits more fun with playful accessories.
pins.what: The bio lists a category, not a point of view.
pins.why: Accessories can be anything, and playful is what every colourful brand says.
pins.how: Say what only Lila does with colour and design in Amsterdam.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: Shoppers compare Lila with any bag brand at a similar price.

pins.area: A pink lobster tote in front of a newsstand fills the hero
pins.what: The site hero shows a pink lobster tote.
pins.why: The grid is built around striped totes, so the picture that opens the site is a product the Instagram does not lead with.
pins.how: Choose the product that stands for Lila and show it in both places.
pins.label: Your site
pins.cost: Visitors from Instagram do not recognise what they came for.

pins.quote: transforming our LILA Amsterdam office into a pottery painting experience
pins.what: Lila turned its office into a pottery studio.
pins.why: A bag brand that hosts an experience in Amsterdam is something no online label can copy.
pins.how: Treat experiences as part of the brand, not a one-off.
pins.label: Your captions
pins.cost: The most memorable idea lives in a pop-up that ends.

sections.intro: You asked for a look at Lila. I spent some time on what people see first. Three things stood out.
